name: Back to the Beginning
label: Quest
description: Back to the Beginning: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I suppose that this is goodbye then, my friend. But, I'll always be here if you want to come back and talk with me from time to time. Probably while you're loitering around waiting for your buddies to join you for a raid on Blackrock Spire.
Go, before I start to cry. Go back to Mokvar in Orgrimmar and tell him what's happened.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am pleased to see that you have survived, friend. You look well, if not a bit more seasoned.
Come, tell me of all that has transpired.
